issues.description: Filter comparison uses loose equality (==) instead of strict (===), risking type coercion bugs.
issues.suggestion: Replace `status == task.status` with `status === task.status` to ensure type-safe comparison.

issues.description: Array.filter is called on every render without memoization, causing unnecessary re-computation.
issues.suggestion: Wrap the filter logic in useMemo with [tasks, activeFilter] as dependencies.

issues.description: Inline arrow function in JSX prop creates a new function reference on every render.
issues.suggestion: Extract `handleFilterChange` as a named callback with useCallback.

codeQuality.summary: TaskFilter component has minor type-safety and performance concerns. The loose equality check is the most critical fix needed.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Core filtering logic is untested; a bug here would break task visibility for all users.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should filter tasks by status", () => { render(<TaskFilter tasks={mockTasks} />); fireEvent.click(getByText("Active")); expect(queryByText("Completed Task")).not.toBeInTheDocument(); });

untestedPaths.location: TaskFilter when tasks array is empty
untestedPaths.reasoning: Empty state UI branch is uncovered; an undefined access could crash the component.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should show empty state when no tasks match filter", () => { render(<TaskFilter tasks={[]} />); expect(getByText(/no tasks/i)).toBeInTheDocument(); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: The "show all" code path has no test coverage.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should show all tasks when filter is all", () => { render(<TaskFilter tasks={mockTasks} filter="all" />); expect(getAllByRole("listitem")).toHaveLength(mockTasks.length); });

testCoverage.summary: No tests exist for TaskFilter. The core filtering function and edge cases (empty list, "all" filter) require immediate coverage.

suggestions.description: Extract filtering logic into a custom hook `useTaskFilter` to separate concerns and improve reusability.
suggestions.before: const filtered = tasks.filter(t => t.status == activeFilter || activeFilter === "all");
suggestions.benefits: Improves testability, reusability across components, and keeps TaskFilter as a pure presentational component.

suggestions.description: Replace manual button array with a data-driven approach using a config array.
suggestions.benefits: Makes adding new filter options trivial and eliminates repetitive JSX.

refactorings.summary: TaskFilter would benefit from extracting filter logic into a custom hook and adopting a data-driven button pattern.

codeQuality.summary: Test file is well-structured. No significant issues found.

testCoverage.summary: Good coverage of the hook. Consider adding integration tests with the component.

refactorings.summary: Test file is clean and well-organized. No refactoring needed.

recommendations.description: Fix loose equality (==) in TaskFilter status comparison to prevent type coercion bugs.
Add unit tests for TaskFilter filtering logic — currently at 0% coverage.
Memoize filtered task array with useMemo to avoid re-computation on unrelated renders.
Extract filter logic into a custom useTaskFilter hook for separation of concerns.
Use useCallback for event handler to avoid creating new function references on every render.
